rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for making something turn or for something rotating.

example.english: I revolve the knob by hand to adjust the radio's volume.
example.traditional: 我用手轉動個旋鈕，調校收音機個音量。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 sau2 zyun3 dung6 go3 syun4 nau2 tiu4 gaau3 sau1 jam1 gei1 go3 jam1 loeng6

rows.note: Use this specifically when something rotates around its own axis, especially a planet.

example.english: The Earth continues to revolve on its axis, which is why we have day and night.
example.traditional: 地球不停自轉，先至形成日夜。
example.jyutping: dei6 kau4 bat1 ting4 zi6 zyun3 sin1 zi3 jing4 sing4 jat6 je6

rows.note: Use this when a body or object moves in an orbit around a central point.

example.english: The moon continues to revolve around the Earth and will not suddenly stop.
example.traditional: 月球繞住地球轉，唔會突然停低。
example.jyutping: jyut6 kau4 jiu2 zyu6 dei6 kau4 zyun3 m4 wui5 dat6 jin4 ting4 dai1
